thread:
Eve: Quick design review note: our in-console help pane labels "Model snapshot" and "Version" are being used interchangeably. The help links say "Open docs" and route to /docs/modeling#versioning but the screen text says snapshot. Confusing for customers and translators.

Marco: Good catch. We should standardize on "Model version" across console copy & docs. API uses "model_version" so that maps nicely.

Priya: Agree. Small UX constraint: the header in the compact pane can't fit "Model version" fully. Suggest using "Version" in UI lists and "Model version" in help lines. Add an aria-label with the full phrase.

Theo: Dev note: links currently use relative paths and our docs SPA sometimes strips hashes. Use absolute URL + hash to ensure anchor works, and add target=_blank + rel=noopener. Also add sr-only text for "opens in new tab".

Eve: Localization note: l10n-bot, can we add a quick glossary entry so translators map "snapshot" -> "model version"? We don't want mixed translations.

l10n-bot: Created gloss task #223: Add glossary term mapping "snapshot" => "model version" and update translation memory entries.

Priya: I'll update Figma tokens and the help pane component to accept an externalAccessibilityLabel prop. Theo, can you change the links and focus behavior on the docs page?

Theo: Yep. I'll make links absolute and ensure docs router preserves hash and focuses the anchor (tabindex=-1 + focus). I'll add a tiny e2e to validate keyboard flow.

Eve: Owners: Priya (design copy + tokens, ETA 2d), Theo (frontend + e2e, ETA 3d), Marco (docs alias + redirect H2, ETA 1d). Chiming in if anything slips. :thumbsup:
